Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

A ridge of high pressure covers Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building slight occasionally moderate in the south overnight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##
